stories.title: Tool Schema Registry Contract Definition
stories.description: Define and centralize a registry mapping each allowlisted tool to its corresponding Pydantic input schema and callable handler, ensuring a single source of truth for validation and dispatch.

stories.title: Tool Router API Interface Alignment
stories.description: Align the tool_router interface with the FastAPI entrypoint to ensure tool invocation requests from the LLM loop are correctly parsed, routed, and returned in a consistent contract.

stories.title: Tool Router Unit and Validation Tests
stories.description: Implement unit tests covering allowlist enforcement, schema validation success/failure cases, and error handling paths to ensure robustness of the routing layer.

stories.title: End-to-End Tool Invocation Integration
stories.description: Validate full integration of tool routing within the agentic loop, including Anthropic tool_use handling, schema validation, dispatch, and response return to the LLM.
